mapper.sql: id, order_no, item_id, buyer_id, seller_id, status, request_remark, cancel_type, cancel_reason, cancelled_by, accepted_at, buyer_confirmed_at, seller_confirmed_at, completed_at, closed_at, expire_at, dispute_reason, disputed_by, created_at, updated_at, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_order (order_no, item_id, buyer_id, seller_id, status, request_remark, expire_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{itemId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{status}, #{requestRemark}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM trade_order WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM trade_order WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND status IN ('DELIVERING', 'BUYER_CONFIRMED', 'SELLER_CONFIRMED', 'DISPUTE') LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM trade_order WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND status = 'PENDING_SELLER' LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM trade_order WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND status = 'PENDING_SELLER' AND id <> #{excludeId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND status = 'PENDING_SELLER'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
SELECT FROM trade_order WHERE status = 'DISPUTE' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE status = 'DISPUTE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND completed_at >= #{from} AND completed_at < #{to}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE status IN ('CANCELLED', 'MANAGEMENT_CLOSED') AND updated_at >= #{from} AND updated_at < #{to}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE status IN ('DELIVERING', 'BUYER_CONFIRMED', 'SELLER_CONFIRMED', 'DISPUTE')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS c FROM trade_order WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS c FROM trade_order WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND completed_at >= #{from} AND completed_at < #{to} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d')
